content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I stopped and called rest, but I didn't get a clear confirmation that I'm next to the ball.

The ball was centered in the bottom camera about 0.2 m ahead. After I stepped forward 0.08 m it disappeared from view, most likely because it is now under the robot's front edge, where the cameras can't see. The robot is standing in an office, roughly 0.8 m from the cardboard boxes, facing the direction where the ball was.

The robot is now resting in a crouch with its motors off, at about 59% battery and charging. To confirm, someone should check the floor just in front of the robot's feet.
